name: service-command
description: kollab service renders the systemd unit (Linux) or launchd plist (macOS) that runs `kollab --detached` under the manager, status says plainly that a folder has no service, and relay serve --print systemd names --install. Nothing is installed.

steps.title: Setup: an empty folder with no service

steps.description: Print the service definition, then ask for status, in a throwaway folder
steps.command: REPO=$PWD; D=$(mktemp -d); cd "$D" && python "$REPO/main.py" service install --print --env KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1; echo "----- PRINT_EXIT=$? -----"; python "$REPO/main.py" service status; echo "----- STATUS_EXIT=$? -----"; cd "$REPO" && rmdir "$D"

steps.title: Test 1: the manager runs kollab --detached with the service flag

steps.description: In the foreground for the manager

steps.title: Test 2: status is plain about a folder with no service

steps.description: Non-zero, so scripts can test it

steps.title: Test 3: the relay's systemd unit names its one-command install

steps.command: python main.py relay serve --domain agents.example.com --print systemd
